resources.description: Clean text from URL, alias of text-scrape.

Append up to 4000 characters to the platform's agent-memory log and return an index id. Storage is platform-wide, not per-wallet, and no endpoint currently reads it back — treat this as a write-only record log.
Keyword search over the live x402 service catalogue, returning matching service ids, names, endpoints and prices. Supports q (query) and limit (1-20).

Browse Polymarket markets by tag/category, with everything you need to trade what you find — conditionId, CLOB token ids, outcome names and prices, current bid/ask, end date and the minimum price tick. Use this when you know the category you want; use x402-poly-price to search by keyword, x402-poly-markets for the overall busiest markets, and x402-polymarket-scan for whole events instead of single markets.
Fetch a webpage safely with SSRF protection and extract its clean text content plus title and meta tags.

Keyword search over the live x402 service catalogue (up to 500 characters of query), returning matching service ids, names, endpoints and prices. Same catalogue search as x402-find, with a longer query limit.
Validate an email address: format check, domain MX-record presence and disposable-email detection. Free — no key or SMTP needed.
Concise text summarization via DeepSeek LLM. Provide text; returns a short summary of the key points.
Decode a JWT token — header, payload, and expiry.
Search tokens by symbol or name via GeckoTerminal, returning matching pools and metadata.
A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME.
Text statistics — word count, readability, sentiment.
Extract tables from Markdown into structured JSON — list of tables, each with headers and row objects.
Generate a QR code for text or a URL.

Scan live Polymarket events ranked by volume, each with its markets inside — one call shows a whole topic rather than a single question. The cheapest entry point in this family: use it to see what is worth looking at, then x402-polymarket-odds for the specific market you pick.
Emoji utilities — lookup, convert, and search.
Enrich company/domain/person with web data + AI.
Color utilities — convert, blend, and manipulate colors.
Live block height + gas for ETH/Base/Polygon.
Fetch a page safely: returns raw HTML, HTTP status and extracted links with SSRF protection. Not a rendered browser view.

Returns the day's A-share dragon-tiger details: listed stocks, top-5 buy/sell seats, institution/hot-money net, listing reason (limit-up/down/turnover/amplitude). Full seat-game panorama.

-- English --
返回当日 A股龙虎榜明细：上榜个股、买卖前五席位、机构/游资净额、上榜原因（涨停/跌停/换手/振幅）。席位博弈全景。

Pass a code; returns the stock's PE/PB historical percentile (where it sits in history), percentile value, historical range and peer comparison. See cheap-or-expensive at a glance.

-- English --
传入代码，返回该股的 PE/PB 历史分位（当前处于历史的百分之多少）、分位值、历史区间与同行对比。一眼看清贵不贵。
Last N blocks base fee + priority fee.
Estimate a cross-chain bridge fee from gas costs (honest gas-based estimate, not a live protocol quote). Provide fromChain, toChain, optional amount.
Current gas price and latest block timestamp for a chain (default base) via direct RPC.
eth_call + RPC reads on 8 chains. Chain, method, params in/out.
Black-box check: does the x402 endpoint verify payment (reject forged txHash/signature/replay) before delivering? Buyer-side trust check before you pay. Returns SAFE/RISK/NOT_X402.
